content.statement: Locusify believes every journey deserves to be remembered. We use the simplest way — your photos — to retrace every step you've taken. Core GPS map features are completely free, with no privacy concerns. Open the app, upload photos, and your travel map is right there.

q1.question: How does Locusify map my travel photos?
q1.answer: Locusify reads GPS coordinates embedded in your photo EXIF data, then plots each photo on an interactive map. It automatically connects the dots to visualize your travel route — all processed locally on your device.

q2.question: Is Locusify free to use?
q2.answer: Yes! Free includes basic templates, unlimited photo uploads, and map trajectory replay. Pro unlocks all premium templates and full customization, while Max adds priority support and early access to new features.

q3.question: Does Locusify upload my photos to a server?
q3.answer: No. All processing happens 100% on your device. Your photos never leave your phone or computer. We don't collect any data — close the app and everything disappears.

q4.question: What photo formats does Locusify support?
q4.answer: Locusify supports JPEG, PNG, HEIC, WebP, and AVIF. Any photo with embedded GPS data will work, and every plan includes unlimited photo uploads.

q5.question: How does the route replay animation work?
q5.answer: Locusify arranges your photos in chronological order, traces the route on the map, and plays an animated journey replay. You can control playback speed and export the animation as a shareable video.

q6.question: Can I export my travel route as a video?
q6.answer: Yes! You can record your route replay animation, preview it, and download the video. Recording relies on browser screen and region capture capabilities, so the latest version of Chrome is recommended.
